# DialogSize

`Flare.Abstractions.DialogSize`

Maximum-width size presets for a Flare dialog (FlareDialog / a component dialog).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Xs` | `0` | Extra-small dialog (max 20 rem). |
| `Sm` | `1` | Small dialog (max 28 rem). |
| `Md` | `2` | Medium dialog (max 35 rem). Default. |
| `Lg` | `3` | Large dialog (max 50 rem). |
| `Xl` | `4` | Extra-large dialog (max 70 rem). |
| `FullScreen` | `5` | Full-screen dialog (nearly the full viewport). |
| `FullWidth` | `6` | Full-width dialog (spans the full viewport width with a small margin). |

## Used by components

- `FlareDialog`
